so basically descrates theorizes there are three types of ideas
  • innate ideas - ideas that are "intrinsic" to a being (example: the idea of self)
  • adventitious ideas - ideas that you gain through experience/the senses (example: the idea of a dog)
  • made up ideas - ideas that come from combining two pre-existing ideas (example: the idea of a unicorn)
